bugs.name: Formula field | Typing in the formula Expression box removes every space, so text in quotes is saved wrong
bugs.description_html:
Summary

In the layout builder, the Space key does nothing in a formula field's Expression box. Every space the admin types is lost, also inside quotes. A formula like concat(first_name, " ", last_name) is saved as concat(first_name,"",last_name), so the result has no space. Pasting text keeps spaces; other text boxes in the app are not affected.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open Settings › Modules and Fields › any module (e.g. Leads) › Layouts › open a layout.

  2. Drag "Formula" from New Fields into a section. The Field Properties panel opens on ADVANCED.

  3. Click in the Expression box and type: concat(qa_text, " ", "High value")

  4. Look at the box.

Expected result

  • The text is kept exactly as typed, with its spaces: concat(qa_text, " ", "High value").

Actual result

  • The box shows concat(qa_text,"","Highvalue"). Every space is gone, including the ones inside quotes.

  • Typing a, Space, b gives "ab".

  • Pasting "x y" keeps the space; typing "a b c" in a record form keeps spaces (control).

  • Same in CRM and Desk.

Notes

  • Formulas without text still work (qa_num*2), which hides the problem; any text joined with spaces or compared with a value containing a space gives a wrong result.

Environment

  • TAVI CRM web (staging-crm.taviportal.com) and TAVI Desk web (staging-desk.taviportal.com), org NDC-Staging, owner account

  • Test modules QA FX (CRM) and QA FX Desk (Desk); Edge (Chromium) on Windows 10; checked 23 Nov 2026

Evidence

  • F01-typed-spaces-dropped-FAIL.png (attached)

  • Test cases: new (found while running M4) — docs/formula-fields (192 cases); run executions/execu_2026-11-23_formula-fields

bugs.name: Formula field | Formulas are not recalculated when a workflow rule or a blueprint transition changes a field they use
bugs.description_html:
Summary

When automation changes a field that a formula reads, the formula keeps its old value. A workflow field update and a blueprint transition both leave the formula stale. The same change made by a user (form, inline edit), the API, import or mass update does recalculate.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a formula field "Double" = qa_num * 2 on a module.

  2. Create a workflow rule on that module: when a record is created, Field Update qa_num = 7.

  3. Create a record with QA Num = 1 and open it.

  4. Blueprint: add a transition that asks for QA Num (CRM) or Priority (Desk Tickets, formula priority = "High") and run it with 7 / High.

Expected result

  • After the rule: QA Num 7, Double 14.

  • After the transition: the formula shows the new result (14 / true).

Actual result

  • CRM workflow: QA Num 7, Double still 2.

  • CRM blueprint: status Closed, QA Num 7, Double still 2.

  • Desk workflow on QA FX Desk: QA Num 7, Double still 2.

  • Desk Tickets blueprint: status On Hold, Priority High, formula priority = "High" still false.

  • Controls: API edit 4 → 10 gives 15; mass update gives 6 on all three records.

Notes

  • Rechecked after a wait: the values stay wrong until someone saves the record again.

Environment

  • TAVI CRM web (staging-crm.taviportal.com) and TAVI Desk web (staging-desk.taviportal.com), org NDC-Staging, owner account

  • Test modules QA FX (CRM) and QA FX Desk (Desk); Edge (Chromium) on Windows 10; checked 23 Nov 2026

Evidence

  • F02-automation-no-recalc-FAIL.png (attached)

  • Test cases: H8, H9 — docs/formula-fields (192 cases); run executions/execu_2026-11-23_formula-fields

bugs.name: Formula field | A field used in a formula can be deleted without warning; the formula then gives wrong values and cannot be saved
bugs.description_html:
Summary

Deleting a field that a formula reads is allowed with no warning. The field usage check does not list formulas. After the delete, new records get a silently wrong formula value (the deleted field counts as blank), and the formula field itself can no longer be saved.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a number field "QA K4" and a formula "QA FX K4" = qa_k4 + 1.

  2. Create a record with QA K4 = 5 (formula shows 6).

  3. Open the field QA K4 and check where it is used, then delete it permanently.

  4. Create a new record.

  5. Open the formula field QA FX K4 and save it (e.g. change its label).

Expected result

  • The usage check lists the formula, and the delete is blocked or warns that QA FX K4 uses this field.

  • If allowed, the formula is clearly marked as broken.

Actual result

  • Usage lists no formulas (workflow rules, views, layout rules, validation rules … all empty).

  • DELETE answers 204 with no warning.

  • New record: QA FX K4 = 1 (blank + 1), no error.

  • Saving the formula field: 422 "Formula for field 'fx_k4' references 'qa_k4', which is not a field on this module."

  • Same on Desk.

Environment

  • TAVI CRM web (staging-crm.taviportal.com) and TAVI Desk web (staging-desk.taviportal.com), org NDC-Staging, owner account

  • Test modules QA FX (CRM) and QA FX Desk (Desk); Edge (Chromium) on Windows 10; checked 23 Nov 2026

Evidence

  • F03-delete-used-field-FAIL.png (attached)

  • Test cases: K4 — docs/formula-fields (192 cases); run executions/execu_2026-11-23_formula-fields

bugs.name: Formula field | Existing records keep the old result after the expression is changed, and stay empty when a formula is added
bugs.description_html:
Summary

Formulas are only worked out when a record is saved. Changing a formula's expression does not update records that already exist, and a new formula field stays empty on all existing records, until each record is saved again.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a formula "Double" = qa_num * 2 and a record with QA Num = 4 (Double 8).

  2. Change the expression to qa_num * 3 and save the layout.

  3. Open the record again after a minute.

  4. Add a new formula "Times5" = qa_num * 5 and open the same record.

Expected result

  • The record shows 12 for the changed formula and 20 for the new one (Zoho recalculates existing records).

Actual result

  • Still 8 after 20 seconds and after about one hour; 12 only after an unrelated edit is saved.

  • The new formula is empty on the existing record.

  • Same on Desk.

Environment

  • TAVI CRM web (staging-crm.taviportal.com) and TAVI Desk web (staging-desk.taviportal.com), org NDC-Staging, owner account

  • Test modules QA FX (CRM) and QA FX Desk (Desk); Edge (Chromium) on Windows 10; checked 23 Nov 2026

bugs.name: Formula field | Lookup, user and department fields give the record id in a formula instead of the name
bugs.description_html:
Summary

When a formula reads a lookup, a user field or the Desk department field, it gets the internal id (a long code) instead of the name shown on screen.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a formula concat(qa_account) where QA Account is a lookup to Accounts.

  2. Create a record with QA Account = "QA FX Acc".

  3. Do the same with a user field (concat(qa_user)) and, on Desk Tickets, concat(department).

Expected result

  • "QA FX Acc", the user's name, and the department name ("Customer Service").

Actual result

  • "59fab8eb-fc45-40a1-9d61-b16fa097f998" (account id), "97be04b6-…" (user id), "7e1ac409-…" (department id).

  • Same on Desk (account cbcc038a-…).

bugs.name: Formula field | Multi-select, multi-select lookup, address and location fields read as empty in a formula
bugs.description_html:
Summary

A formula that reads a multi-select, a multi-select lookup, an address or a location field always gets an empty value, with no error, even when the record has a value.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create formulas concat(qa_msel), len(qa_msel), concat(qa_accs), concat(qa_address), concat(qa_loc).

  2. Create a record with QA MSel = A, C; QA Accounts = QA FX Acc; an address (1 Nile St, Cairo, Egypt); a location (30.04, 31.23).

Expected result

  • Readable values (e.g. "A; C", the account name, the address text), or the field is refused when the formula is saved.

Actual result

  • All return "" (len 0). The values are stored on the record.

  • Same on Desk.

bugs.name: Formula field | The formula return type is not enforced, and the layout builder does not save one
bugs.description_html:
Summary

A formula can be saved with return type "number" and an expression that returns text, or "date" with an expression that returns a number. The result is stored anyway. The layout builder has no return-type control and saves none.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a formula with return type number and expression upper(qa_text); record QA Text = "ab".

  2. Create a formula with return type date and expression qa_num + 1; record QA Num = 4.

  3. Add a formula from the layout builder and read the field definition.

Expected result

  • The mismatch is refused when the formula is saved, or the result is empty.

  • The admin chooses the return type (Zoho asks for it first).

Actual result

  • "AB" stored in the number formula; 5 stored in the date formula.

  • Builder: no return type saved (only the expression).

  • Unknown return types (currency, datetime) are correctly refused (control).

Environment

  • TAVI CRM web (staging-crm.taviportal.com) and TAVI Desk web (staging-desk.taviportal.com), org NDC-Staging, owner account

  • Test modules QA FX (CRM) and QA FX Desk (Desk); Edge (Chromium) on Windows 10; checked 23 Nov 2026

  2. Record: QA Num 4, QA Dec 2, QA Num2 empty.

bugs.name: Formula field | Layout builder shows raw server messages for broken formulas and names only the first one
bugs.description_html:
Summary

The builder lets an empty or broken formula be applied, then the Save fails with the raw API message. With two broken formulas only the first is named. concat(,"a") is not marked invalid while typing.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Drop a Formula field, leave the expression empty, Apply, Save.

  2. Add two formulas: qa_num # 2 and (qa_num, Apply both, Save.

  3. Type concat(,"a") in the Expression box.

Expected result

  • "A formula field needs an expression before the layout can be saved." in the panel; both broken formulas named; concat(,"a") marked invalid.

Actual result

  • Toast "Field 'formula': Option 'expression' is required."

  • Toast names only the first formula ("Unexpected character '#' at position 7.").

  • concat(,"a") not flagged (the server refuses it).

Environment

  • TAVI CRM web (staging-crm.taviportal.com) and TAVI Desk web (staging-desk.taviportal.com), org NDC-Staging, owner account

bugs.name: Formula field | Formulas break silently when a pick-list option is renamed; same-version layout saves are both accepted
bugs.description_html:
Summary

Three smaller issues: renaming a pick-list option used in a formula leaves the old text in the formula, so the result silently turns false; two saves of the same layout version are both accepted (the last one wins); the Expression box error is not linked for screen readers.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Formula qa_pick = "Blue"; rename the option Blue to Navy; create a record with Navy.

  2. Save the same layout twice from two tabs without reloading.

  3. Inspect the Expression box while it shows an error.

Expected result

  • Warning or the formula updated to "Navy"; the second save gets a conflict; aria-describedby points to the message.

Actual result

  • Formula still "Blue", result false, no warning; both saves 200; no aria-describedby.

bugs.name: Formula field | Desk assignment rules do not accept formula fields in their conditions
bugs.description_html:
Summary

A Desk ticket formula field cannot be used in an assignment rule condition: the rule is refused with "unknown_field". Other custom fields, Priority and Channel are accepted, and workflow rules do accept formula fields.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Add a formula field to Tickets, e.g. "QA FX High" = priority = "High".

  2. Open Settings › Automation › Assignment Rules › new direct rule.

  3. Add a condition on "QA FX High" equals true and save.

Expected result

  • The formula field is offered and the rule saves, as for other custom fields.

Actual result

  • 400 VALIDATION_ERROR "targets[0].criteria.conditions[1].field_key: unknown_field". A custom email field, Priority and Channel save fine.

Environment

  • TAVI Desk web (staging-desk.taviportal.com), org NDC-Staging, owner account; Tickets module, department Customer Service

  • Edge (Chromium) on Windows 10; checked 23 Nov 2026

Evidence

  • F13-assignment-rule-criteria-FAIL.png (attached)

  • Test cases: I8 — docs/formula-fields (192 cases); run executions/execu_2026-11-23_formula-fields
